full_judgment: (a) In all cases of custodial rape burden of proof be shifted to the accused of the rape to prove that sexual intercourse was not against the will and without the consent of the victim. There should be a presumption that it was not consensual and the accused must bear the burden of showing that it was consensual. Section 375, 376 of the Penal Code, Section 644of Act 18/95 section 9 of Act 8/2000 be amended accordingly.
